entities.summary: Simon Pereyns was a Flemish painter. He moved to Lisbon, Portugal in 1558 and later to Madrid, Spain. In 1566, he moved to Mexico where he gained fame as a painter of numerous works, most of which have not survived. He created the altarpiece of Huejotzingo at the Franciscan convent of Huejotzingo in Puebla, Mexico, one of the monasteries on the slopes of Popocatépetl. Included in his works is a depiction of Saint Christopher. Simon Pereyns was a authors & novelists from Antwerp (1530, Antwerp–1589). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
